boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UB study settings for quiet work, group projects, and academic support across North and South Campus.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library – 1st Floor Study Area
cards.title: Lockwood’s first-floor study area
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, North Campus
cards.notes: Bring a partner or small group and use the long tables for a working session; the library describes this area as conversational.
cards.short_summary: A daylight-filled, conversational table area for shared coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes Lockwood’s first-floor study area as a conversational space with long tables for collaboration or studying with friends.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: See current library hours and visitor guidance before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library – 2nd Floor Study Booths
cards.title: Lockwood’s second-floor study booths
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, North Campus
cards.notes: Choose a booth when your group needs a defined table setup, then move on when you finish so others can use the space.
cards.short_summary: Booth seating designed to make longer study sessions more comfortable.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries identifies Lockwood Memorial Library’s second-floor study booths as a study space with supportive seating and a layout for extended work.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: See current library hours and visitor guidance before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library – 3rd Floor Group Study Room
cards.title: Lockwood’s third-floor group study room
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, North Campus
cards.notes: Reserve a room through UB Libraries when your group needs a shared screen and whiteboard for a presentation or planning session.
cards.short_summary: A reservable group room with a screen and whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries lists Lockwood’s third-floor group study room as a collaborative space with a large table, wall-mounted screen, and whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: Group study rooms are reservable by active UB students, faculty, and staff; review reservation rules first.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library – 3rd Floor Study Area
cards.title: Lockwood’s third-floor open study area
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the flexible seating for a project meeting, or pick an open seat for solo work while staying mindful of the shared setting.
cards.short_summary: An open third-floor area with seating for groups and individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes Lockwood’s third-floor study area as having varied seating for group work and an open design with natural light.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: See current library hours and visitor guidance before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library – 4th Floor Open Study Carrels
cards.title: Lockwood’s fourth-floor open carrels
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, North Campus
cards.notes: Set up at an individual carrel when you need desk space for reading or writing, and keep calls outside this quiet study setting.
cards.short_summary: Individual desks balancing privacy with an open, light-filled layout.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes Lockwood’s fourth-floor open study carrels as individual workspaces with personal desk areas and natural light.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: See current library hours and visitor guidance before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lockwood Memorial Library – 5th Floor Comfortable Seating
cards.title: Lockwood’s fifth-floor comfortable seating
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Memorial Library, North Campus
cards.notes: Pick a chair that fits your reading or laptop work, and preserve the quiet atmosphere for everyone sharing the floor.
cards.short_summary: Quiet fifth-floor seating with several individual study options.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes Lockwood’s fifth-floor comfortable seating as a calm, quiet area with cushioned chairs, lounge seats, and desk chairs.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: See current library hours and visitor guidance before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Oscar A. Silverman Library – 2nd Floor Individual Study Seating
cards.title: Silverman’s second-floor individual seating
cards.subtitle: Oscar A. Silverman Library in Capen Hall, North Campus
cards.notes: Use a divided station for independent reading or writing, especially when you need personal space without reserving a room.
cards.short_summary: Side-by-side study stations with built-in dividers.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes Silverman Library’s second-floor individual study seating as side-by-side stations with built-in dividers for independent work.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: See current library hours and visitor guidance before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Oscar A. Silverman Library – 3rd Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Silverman’s third-floor group rooms
cards.subtitle: Oscar A. Silverman Library in Capen Hall, North Campus
cards.notes: Book a group room for a presentation rehearsal or collaborative assignment, using the screen and whiteboard to organize the work.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative rooms equipped for shared viewing and brainstorming.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries lists Silverman Library’s third-floor group study rooms as spaces with tables, wall-mounted screens, and whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: Group study rooms are reservable by active UB students, faculty, and staff; review reservation rules first.

cards.title: The Law Library’s second-floor reading room
cards.subtitle: Law Library, North Campus
cards.notes: Meet a classmate for a quiet work block or spread out your materials at a table; keep the shared reading-room setting considerate.
cards.short_summary: A well-lit reading room suited to individual or group study.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries describes the Law Library’s second-floor reading room as an open, well-lit space suitable for individual and group study.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: See current library hours and visitor guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Evans Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Evans Hall, North Campus residential area
cards.notes: If you have residential swipe access, use this lounge for a late evening study block and check Campus Living updates before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A residence-area study lounge open by swipe access into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Campus Living lists Evans Study Lounge as open daily from 6:30 a.m. to midnight by swipe access.
cards.source_title: Academic Success Centers & Study Spaces | University at Buffalo Campus Living
cards.access_notes: Daily 6:30 a.m.–12 a.m. by swipe access, per Campus Living; access is intended for eligible residents.
